# MCP client conformance peer

`server.py` is an independent, test-only JSON-RPC stdio implementation of the
MCP 2025-11-25 subset used by EPIC-07.03. Production protocol/lifecycle behavior
is Rust. The peer asserts initialize/initialized ordering and exercises tools,
resources/templates, prompt listing, tool calls, resource reads and ping.
Modes inject pagination, incompatible versions, malformed frames, wrong IDs,
disconnection, remote errors, unsupported server requests, notifications,
slow responses, tool execution errors and invalid result schemas. An optional
log file records subprocess configuration for cleanup/environment assertions.

`gateway-daemon/tests/mcp_client.rs` calls the public driving application port
with explicit test admission/mapping/normalization adapters. Unit tests inject
transport faults for cases not reliably generated by OS scheduling. These are
synthetic conformance results, not live provider or production policy evidence.

Run: `cargo test -p gateway-daemon --lib --test mcp_client --locked`.
See `docs/mcp-client-runtime.md` and the quality gate manifest for coverage.
